from decimal import Decimal
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Optional
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, model_validator

class LendingProductBase(BaseModel):
    name: str
    description: Optional[str] = None
    min_amount: Decimal = Field(gt=0)
    max_amount: Decimal = Field(gt=0)
    min_term_months: int = Field(gt=0)
    max_term_months: int = Field(gt=0)
    base_interest_rate: Decimal = Field(ge=0)
    is_active: bool = True

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def check_ranges(self):
        if self.min_amount > self.max_amount:
            raise ValueError("min_amount > max_amount")
        if self.min_term_months > self.max_term_months:
            raise ValueError("min_term > max_term")
        return self

class LendingProductCreate(LendingProductBase):
    pass

class LendingProductUpdate(BaseModel):
    name: Optional[str] = None
    description: Optional[str] = None
    min_amount: Optional[Decimal] = Field(default=None, gt=0)
    max_amount: Optional[Decimal] = Field(default=None, gt=0)
    min_term_months: Optional[int] = Field(default=None, gt=0)
    max_term_months: Optional[int] = Field(default=None, gt=0)
    base_interest_rate: Optional[Decimal] = Field(default=None, ge=0)
    is_active: Optional[bool] = None

class LendingProductOut(LendingProductBase):
    id: int
    created_at: datetime
    updated_at: datetime
    model_config = {"from_attributes": True}
